artifacts.sourceDeployment: Postgres read source opened by createDataClient in scripts/lib/data-client.ts: --target <url>, else TARGET_POSTGRES_URL, POSTGRES_POOLED_URL or POSTGRES_DIRECT_URL. The package script runs bun with --env-file=/dev/null, so no .env file is loaded and every variable must be set in the shell. DATA_BACKEND=postgres is required. REPLICATION_MEDIA_BASE_URL must be the approved https media origin (assertDeploymentEnv in lib/postgres/runtime/deploymentEnv.ts). A non-loopback host also needs --allow-remote and POSTGRES_IMPORT_CONFIRM equal to its hostname (guardTarget in scripts/postgres/targetGuard.ts), even though the run only reads. No admin-intent token is needed.
